synthesis:draft.headline: POE10 denotes a low probability-of-exceedance demand: the forecast level that only a small proportion of actual demand outcomes are expected to exceed.

document_statements.quote: The probability of exceedance (POE) demand is the probability or the likelihood the forecast would be met or exceeded.
The 10% probability of exceedance (POE) demand is the value that 10% of the actual demand values are expected to be above and 90% of the actual demand values are expected to be below.
OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE10 (number(15,2)): 10% probability of exceedance operational demand forecast value.
